summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new Vehicle Type (Type de véhicule) configuration editor on /admin/vehicle-types. End-to-end flow validated: login → list → create → edit → duplicate → delete. All 12 testable feature areas of the editor (identity, currency, icon/show-as, fare strategy, ride feature toggles, base pricing, zone overrides, waiting/cancellation, capacity, 3 surge schedules, 34-language translations w/ LLM auto-translate + copy-all, image upload zones, save) worked as expected. Backend integration through /api/admin/vehicle-types and /api/admin/vehicle-types/translate is fully functional.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> at VehicleTypeEditor:218 (CURRENCIES <select>). Caused by Visual-Edit tooling injecting an x-excluded <span style=display:contents> inside <option>. Cosmetic dev-only warning; does not affect functionality. Consider filtering option children or suppressing the Visual-Edit wrapper for <option>.

action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Investigate the React hydration warning for <span> inside <option> coming from the Visual-Edit instrumentation in VehicleTypeEditor.jsx CURRENCIES select. No user-visible impact.
critical_code_review_comments: Toggle switches (vt-pool, vt-pet, vt-assist, vt-wa, vt-otp, vt-peak_slot1-toggle, etc.) work correctly visually (color/position changes), but the root toggle element className does not change between states; only inner span transform updates. Recommend adding aria-pressed / data-state='on|off' attribute on the toggle root so automated tests and screen readers can detect state reliably.

Peak-slot day enable mechanism: clicking vt-peak_slot1-day-mon does activate the day, but the corresponding start/end/price inputs may use a different testid pattern than `vt-peak_slot1-mon-start` (could not locate that exact id). Recommend standardizing testids for surge day inputs (e.g., vt-peak_slot1-mon-start / -end / -price) to make automated regression testing trivial.
seed_data_creation: Temporary vehicle type 'qa-eco' was created, edited, duplicated (cancelled), and finally deleted as part of the full CRUD test cycle. Final count is back to 14 (matches pre-test state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: VehicleTypeEditor on /admin/vehicle-types is production-ready. CRUD + LLM auto-translate (claude-sonnet-4-6 via emergentintegrations) verified end-to-end. Toast notifications work ('Type de véhicule créé', 'mis à jour', 'Supprimé', '✨ traduction'). Pool toggle warning displays correctly. 34-language grid expands with vt-toggle-translations and Copy partout / Traduire automatiquement both populate vt-tr-{lang} fields. Slug auto-formats (lowercase + space→hyphen) and is disabled in edit mode. Duplicate opens with empty slug and name suffixed '(copie)'. Only outstanding nit: Visual-Edit-related React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in CURRENCIES select.
